_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `opencode acp` 1.19.1 driven over stdio against a local OpenAI-compatible stub on a loopback port, so no provider credential and no network were involved, with a throwaway HOME. Agent-to-client lines in order, on one session. The stub provider serves two models: think-1, declared reasoning-capable, and plain-1, which is not. The session/new result opens on think-1 and advertises an effort select (category thought_level) offering low, medium, high and default, current low. A session/set_config_option write of effort=high reads back high, and one of effort=low reads back low; the stub recorded each turn's chat request carrying reasoning_effort equal to the value just written. A write of effort=max, a level think-1 does not offer, is refused -32602 'effort not found: max'. A model write to plain-1 answers configOptions with no effort select at all, and a model write back to think-1 answers it again with current low: the switch reset the variant to the model's first one. Reductions: the session id replaced with the synthetic opencode-session-1; the model select cut to the two stub models; the two turns between the writes dropped whole, along with the available_commands_update.
